# datadog_ai_gateway_model_group (Resource)

Provides a Datadog AI Gateway model group resource. A model group selects the models, providers, and routing rules that its members can use, and the request options that apply to them. This resource manages named model groups only, not the organization-wide default model group. This resource is in Preview.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_ai_gateway_model_group" "coding" {
  name                = "Coding models"
  model_ids           = [101, 102]
  provider_ids        = [3]
  routing_rule_slugs  = ["coding-route"]
  allow_fast_mode     = false
  max_reasoning_level = "high"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the model group.

### Optional

- `allow_fast_mode` (Boolean) Whether fast mode is allowed for the models and routing rules in the group. Defaults to `true`.
- `max_reasoning_level` (String) Maximum reasoning level permitted for requests that use the group. No group-specific limit applies when unset. Valid values are `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`.
- `model_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of individually selected model catalog entries. Individual selections do not include models added to a provider later.
- `provider_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of selected providers. A provider selection covers the provider's current and future models.
- `routing_rule_slugs` (Set of String) Slugs of selected routing rules, such as `coding-route`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import datadog_ai_gateway_model_group.coding "<model_group_id>"
```
